summary: The ISS-CAPTUREMAKER-002 retained corpus stale-duration-source.mkv (sha256 d07c93e97ca281bf1c53c3aabf6a34d5ba56fd417256b9efdb75b9d432f42de7) is untracked and gone from disk, so the exact-bytes replay cannot run. finalize-original-eof.test.mjs now rebuilds it from the recorded recipe as a declared stand-in (different SHA256 each run: the muxer stamps non-deterministic header bytes, and ffmpeg 8.1.1 here vs 9.0.2 when recorded).
fix_direction: If the original bytes resurface, drop them at the evidence path and the test uses them automatically; otherwise accept the stand-in or commit a small (<1 MB) deterministic fixture.

title: No test drives runFinalize recovery with a .playable.webm --video
detail: Mutant originalVideo->video at the recovery call (record-commands.ts:293/297) survives; code is correct today by direct probe.
fix_direction: Add a case to original-capture.test.ts asserting finalize arg 11 is the raw .webm when --video is .playable.webm.

title: Private-capture remux guard is name-based
detail: record-finalize.ts:179 matches the .playable.webm suffix only; normalizeCapture always uses that suffix so no other producer exists today.
fix_direction: Carry an explicit remux flag/provenance field instead of a filename check if another producer appears.
